From: Alex Turner <alex@lumenmart.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 03 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick question — exploring Redwood for search ranking rerank

Hi Chloe,

I signed up for the trial yesterday (thanks for making that easy). We're looking at using Redwood Inference to power a reranking endpoint that enriches search results with product descriptions and buyer signals. Before we book a demo, I wanted to share a quick snapshot of our expected traffic and timelines and check if Redwood supports per-customer routing (we have a few large retail partners).

High-level:
- Use case: search + rerank for e-commerce catalog (product copy + buyer intent features)
- Avg daily queries (current prod): ~120k/day; peak ~20k/hr during promos
- Typical request size: prompt ~600 tokens (post-aggregation)
- Timeline: pilot in mid-September, production early Nov if pilot goes well

Attached is a small CSV with sample traffic slices for Jan–Jun. Would love a 30–40 minute demo focused on throughput, cost controls, and routing options. Our PM and infra lead can join.

Thanks,
Alex Turner
Product Manager, LumenMart
attachments: lumenmart-traffic-jan-jun.csv (CSV), product-brief.pdf (PDF)
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Turner <alex@lumenmart.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 03 Aug 2026 10:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick question — exploring Redwood for search ranking rerank

Hi Alex — great to meet you and thanks for the traffic file. Ben (cc'd) is our SDR who will help get this scheduled. A few quick intake questions so we tailor the demo to your needs: 

1) For the pilot, do you expect the traffic profile to be steady across the day or concentrated in promo windows? (You noted peaks — do those last hours or days?)
2) Do you need data isolation (dedicated pool) for the pilot, or can you start on hosted with token-level access controls?
3) Any compliance constraints (SOC2 / data residency) we should be aware of before the call?

Propose three demo windows (30–40m) — pick the one that works and we'll send a calendar invite:
- Wed Aug 5, 10:00–10:40 AM PT
- Wed Aug 5, 2:00–2:40 PM PT
- Thu Aug 6, 11:00–11:40 AM PT

If none work, tell us a couple of times that do. We'll prepare a short throughput/cost sketch using your CSV and demo the routing/fallback behavior.

—Chloe
Chloe Martin
Sr. Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Alex Turner <alex@lumenmart.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
Cc: product@lumenmart.com
Date: Wed, 05 Aug 2026 08:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick question — exploring Redwood for search ranking rerank

Thanks Chloe — answers below and the PM will join.

1) Peak behavior: promo peaks are concentrated but can last 6–12 hours; outside of promos traffic is relatively steady.
2) For the pilot we can start on hosted, but we will likely move to dedicated if the latency/cost targets align.
3) Compliance: SOC2 is required; data residency is US-only for now.

Any of the proposed slots work for us except Thu morning. Wed 2:00 PM PT is preferred.

Also: our infra lead (Maya Singh, maya.s@lumenmart.com) might join — adding her on follow-up calendar invite if that’s ok.

Alex
